description: SolarSpatialTools is a Python package with methods for spatial analysis of solar-resource and photovoltaic-generation data. Its own README describes algorithms intended for distributed solar observations, where a single time series is insufficient to represent many roofs or a large plant. The user supplies locations, irradiance or production records and analysis settings; geographic coverage and time span follow those inputs. The public source and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. Spatial results can help estimate correlated PV output, choose placement assumptions or prepare distributed-generation inputs for grid simulation. A caveat is that cloud movement and local shading can vary faster than sparse sensors capture, so extrapolated fields require checks. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS article, repository and README were inspected without obtaining solar measurements or running an analysis.
name: SolarSpatialTools spatial solar analysis
